title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — October 07, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C7.9 (Peaked October 07, 2026 at 13:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 347 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

The Sun will eventually swell into a red giant, likely engulfing Mercury and Venus — and possibly Earth. ✨🤍

A bright active region stands out near the center of the Sun, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward eruption.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
